idea: How to stop checking your phone at work
text:
You’re staring at your phone every five minutes at work [pause], right? Here’s the thing [look at camera].

You will stop the urge to check your phone without distractions [confident], here’s how it works.

Put your phone in a drawer [pause], set a timer for 15 minutes [look at camera], focus on one task [pause], remove the phone completely [confident].

You now have control over your attention [pause], no more checking.
title: Stop Checking Your Phone at Work
